highlights: Merge branches in Git View. Inspect Base, Ours, and Theirs, edit a working result, and continue or abort after reopening Dirlume.
Stage individual text hunks or multiple files. Review discard, amend commits, and preserve staged and working versions with stashes.
Cherry-pick or revert commits, reorder or combine commits during rebase, preview resets, and recover commits from the reflog.
Clone or initialize repositories, manage remotes and upstreams, fetch, pull, and review branch or tag pushes and deletions.
Manage linked worktrees and submodules, transfer Git LFS objects, run a bisect, and open a terminal at the active worktree.
